title: Choose the Visual World for OpenPulse
question: The roll assigned Signal Oscilloscope & Precision Bench. Choose the foundational design system and visual world for OpenPulse.

options.label: Signal Oscilloscope & Precision Bench
options.lineage: scientific lab oscilloscopes & precision telemetry benches
options.thesis: The developer analytics platform as a high-precision digital signal bench: etched graticules, phosphor pulse traces, and zero decorative SaaS fluff.
options.viewport: High-density real-time pulse stream over an etched division graticule, instant query timebases, and compact signal cards.
options.risk: Can feel overly esoteric if standard data tables lose scanability.

raised.raise: Flat, razor-sharp architectural layout planes prevent retro-CRT novelty and anchor clean modern usability.

options.label: Precision Instrument Bench
options.lineage: Modern technical IDEs and industrial telemetry workstations
options.thesis: Dense, razor-sharp dark UI engineered for instantaneous query comprehension and keyboard-first navigation.
options.viewport: Compact navigation rail, multi-metric KPI sparklines, and 32px dense data grid.
options.risk: Closer to modern developer tools (Vercel, Grafana, Linear) but highly familiar and battle-tested.

options.label: Precisionist Industrial Plate
options.lineage: Hard-edged architectural planes and precisionist industrial plates
options.thesis: Telemetry organized into clean, unmodulated planes lit by razor-sharp border contrast.
options.viewport: Stark planar panels partitioning event ingestion from query inspection.
options.case: Provides intense structural discipline and zero clutter; slightly rigid for fluid multi-series charts.
options.risk: Extreme minimalism can under-communicate interactive states.

options.label: HyperCard Shoebox Stack
options.case: Too retro-novelty for high-velocity real-time telemetry streaming.
options.kept: Card linking and immediate in-place drill-down inspection.

canonCard.label: Modern Dark Cloud Telemetry
canonCard.thesis: The industry-standard dark mode developer SaaS dashboard (Datadog/PostHog style) executed with high craft.
canonCard.viewport: Standard left sidebar, top breadcrumb bar, grid of rounded metric cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from generic SaaS platforms; lacks distinctive OpenPulse identity.
